description: This file defines the SudoCommand interface within the policies commands for the Ditto service, including constants for resource type and JSON fields, as well as default method implementations.

classes.name: SudoCommand
classes.description: Interface for all sudo commands encapsulating type prefix, resource type, and JSON field definitions.

classes.name: SudoCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions related to sudo commands, such as policy ID and selected fields.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string for sudo commands.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer, indicating no specific resource path.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto headers on the command instance.
